title: DeeBlok - Sippin 'n Vibe'n
htmlContent:
DeeBlok releases a new single called "Sippin 'n Vibe'n". The flow hits hard and is filled with engaging energy, that makes you feel the passion for the music, while the lyrics are raw and filled with conviction to make you feel it on a real level.

"Sippin 'n Vibe'n" is an undeniable record, that doesn’t waste a single second proving it’s worth to the listener. It’s exciting and powerful, while they not only show off his impressive skill set, but makes music for the people to enjoy.
